activity_context.topic_title: The Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation

feedback.problem: What is the linear transformation $T$ whose standard matrix is $T=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 8 \\ -3 & 2\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Consider a general vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}].$ Multiplying by the matrix $T,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-4 & 8 \\ -3 & 2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4x+8y \\ -3x+2y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $\,T\,$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-4x+8y \\ -3x+2y\end{aligned}].
$$
